name: Mahatma Gandhi
zhName: 莫罕达斯·卡拉姆昌德·甘地
summary: Indian lawyer and political organiser whose practice of nonviolent resistance helped broaden the independence movement and influenced campaigns for civil rights beyond India.
zhSummary: 印度律师与政治活动组织者，以非暴力抵抗实践推动独立运动扩大参与，并影响了印度以外的民权运动。
sections: A lawyer becomes an organiser
从律师到社会活动组织者

Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, widely known as Mahatma Gandhi, was born in Porbandar on 2 October 1869. He trained in law in London before going to South Africa in 1893. Discrimination there drew him into organising the Indian community, including the Natal Indian Congress in 1894. His political methods developed through experience, argument and cooperation with others, rather than appearing fully formed at the beginning of his career.
莫罕达斯·卡拉姆昌德·甘地，通常被称为圣雄甘地，于 1869 年 10 月 2 日出生于波尔班达尔。他在伦敦接受法律训练，1893 年前往南非。当地的歧视促使他投身印度侨民的组织工作，包括于 1894 年成立纳塔尔印度人大会。他的政治方法是在实践、讨论及与他人的合作中逐步形成的，并非在生涯之初便已成熟。
Satyagraha as organised resistance
作为有组织抵抗的坚持真理

From 1906 Gandhi developed satyagraha in campaigns against discriminatory legislation in South Africa. Often translated as holding firmly to truth, it joined refusal to cooperate with injustice to a discipline of nonviolence and willingness to accept punishment. It was active resistance, not simple submission. In Hind Swaraj, written in 1909, he connected political self-rule with ethical self-restraint and criticised aspects of modern civilisation. These were arguments for public debate, not a universally accepted programme.
自 1906 年起，甘地在南非反对歧视性立法的运动中发展了“坚持真理”的抵抗方法。这一理念把拒绝与不义合作，同非暴力纪律及承担惩罚的意愿联系起来。它是一种主动抵抗，而非单纯顺从。在 1909 年写成的《印度自治》中，他将政治自治与道德上的自我约束相联系，并批评现代文明的若干方面。这些是参与公共讨论的主张，并非得到普遍接受的方案。
Broadening the independence movement
扩大独立运动的参与

Returning to India in 1915, Gandhi developed local campaigns and became a leading figure in nationwide non-cooperation. The use of homespun cloth linked political protest to daily habits and village livelihoods. The Salt March of 1930 challenged British control of salt and made an everyday necessity a focus of civil disobedience. Its impact depended on many organisers and participants, including women who expanded the movement beyond Gandhi's own march. Independence cannot be explained as the work of one person alone.
1915 年返回印度后，甘地开展地方性运动，并成为全国不合作运动的主要人物。提倡土布把政治抗议同日常习惯及乡村生计联系起来。1930 年的食盐进军挑战英国对食盐的控制，使一种生活必需品成为公民不服从运动的焦点。运动的影响离不开众多组织者与参与者，包括把行动扩展到甘地本人进军路线之外的妇女。印度独立不能被解释为一个人的功劳。
Social reform and the demands of nonviolence
社会改革与非暴力的要求

Gandhi campaigned against untouchability, supported village work and sought cooperation between religious communities. His approach to caste and political representation nevertheless differed sharply from that of B. R. Ambedkar and other Dalit leaders; opposition to untouchability did not amount to agreement on how caste should be dismantled. Nonviolence also placed limits on his own political campaigns. After violence at Chauri Chaura in 1922, he suspended mass civil disobedience, showing the tension between mobilisation and the discipline he demanded.
甘地反对“不可接触制”，支持乡村工作，并寻求不同宗教社群的合作。不过，他对种姓及政治代表权的主张，与比姆拉奥·拉姆吉·安贝德卡尔及其他达利特领袖存在明显分歧；反对“不可接触制”并不等于各方已就如何消除种姓制度达成一致。非暴力原则也限制着他自己的政治行动。1922 年乔里乔拉发生暴力事件后，他暂停了大规模公民不服从运动，体现出动员群众与维持其所要求的纪律之间的张力。
Independence, reconciliation and influence
独立、和解与后世影响

Gandhi supported the Quit India movement in 1942 and was detained with other leaders. When independence and partition came in 1947, he opposed communal violence and worked among affected communities rather than taking government office. The creation of independent India and Pakistan was accompanied by mass displacement and killings; the achievement of independence did not fulfil his hope for religious reconciliation. He was assassinated in Delhi on 30 January 1948.

His writings and campaigns later influenced Martin Luther King Jr. and other advocates of nonviolent political action. Such movements adapted his ideas to their own circumstances rather than simply copying an Indian model. This account concentrates on resistance, social activity and influence; it does not present those contributions as an exhaustive assessment of his life or every position he held.
甘地于 1942 年支持“退出印度”运动，随后与其他领袖一同被拘禁。1947 年独立与印巴分治到来时，他反对社群暴力，在受影响地区工作，而没有担任政府职务。印度与巴基斯坦的独立伴随着大规模流离失所和杀戮；独立的实现并未完成他对宗教和解的期望。1948 年 1 月 30 日，他在德里遇刺身亡。
他的著作与运动后来影响了马丁·路德·金及其他倡导非暴力政治行动的人。这些运动根据各自处境调整其思想，而非简单复制印度模式。本文着重介绍抵抗实践、社会活动及其影响，并不把这些贡献当作对其一生或所有立场的完整评价。

review: 逐项核对生卒日、1893南非、1894大会、1906运动、1909著作、1915回国、1922暂停、1930食盐进军、1942拘禁、1947分治。政府年表把赴英学法和返印合列1891，存在混排疑点，本页不据此写赴英年份。年表给进军人数/里程的口径与常见记载不一，本页不采用这些数字。社会改革不能写成消除种姓；独立同时保留分治暴力背景；不将群众与妇女贡献归给甘地一人。政府年表与Stanford正文已读取，另两篇文章通过搜索索引核对观点，未把传记全文复制入本站。图片改选明确授权的Bundesarchiv文件，排除1931 Elliott & Fry（美国版权疑点）、1929及1931不明首次发表候选。
